title: Outlook for Net Formation of Businesses
what_it_is: Outlook for Net Formation of Businesses

sections.label: Net business formation outlook by sector
sections.summary: MTI expects net business formation to remain subdued for the rest of 2019, with most sectors seeing falls amid global economic uncertainties.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Trade and Industry (a) what is the expected outlook for the net formation (formation minus cessation) of businesses by sector in 2019; (b) which sectors are seeing declining net formation trends and what are the likely causes for the declines; (c) what efforts are being introduced to ensure net formation remains healthy over the coming years; and (d) whether there will be a continued level of "healthy" cessation of businesses.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: This is about a quarter lower than the average of around 13,800 recorded over the same period between 2014 and 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Most sectors saw a fall in the net formation of business entities during this period, including the transportation and storage, business services and construction sectors.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Heightened economic uncertainties in the global economy and the resulting slowdown in the Singapore economy are likely to be factors contributing to this trend.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Trade and Industry (MTI) expects the net formation of businesses to remain subdued for the rest of 2019.

sections.label: GoBusiness Licensing portal for food services
sections.summary: MTI launched the GoBusiness Licensing portal for food services on 31 October, reducing regulatory touchpoints from 14 to one and data fields from over 800 to below 100.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: For instance, MTI launched the GoBusiness Licensing portal for food services on 31 October, which reduces the number of regulatory touchpoints for businesses from 14 to one and the number of data fields required from more than 800 to below 100.

sections.label: Startup SG ecosystem support
sections.summary: Startup SG was established in 2017 to give startups access to a wide range of local financial and non-financial support.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Third, we will continue to develop a vibrant startup ecosystem.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: We established Startup SG in 2017 to provide startups with access to a wide range of local financial and non-financial support.

sections.label: Business churn and resource reallocation
sections.summary: There are no targets for firm exit levels; churn lets resources of land and labour be channelled to more competitive, productive companies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: Firms that are able to offer better services, better products, better able to meet customers' needs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: So, we do not have targets in terms of what are the levels of firms exiting the economy.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: But certainly, I think this process of allowing the churn – firms that are not doing well, exiting; firms that are more competitive, more productive, doing better, coming in – so that the resources of land, labour, these resources are then better able to be channelled to the more competitive and more productive companies.
